row: Soft Paws Animal Clinic • Dr Antonio Jackson

This channel describes the story of a young boy raised in an under privileged town name Mansfield, Louisiana and how he over came adversity. This channel serves to educate the viewers and serve as behind the scene insight about veterinary medicine on a daily basis. Dr. Jackson will allow you follow his everyday journey of practicing veterinary medicine life visually through this channel.  Dr. Jackson Is from Mansfield,  Louisiana. He received a bachelors degree from Southern University and A and M College in Baton Rouge Louisiana. He then completed a Masters of Science degree at Tuskegee University and lastly completed his Doctor of Veterinary Medicine Degree from Tuskegee University.
